summary: Implementation plan for rebuilding the Antigravity research layer. Identifies the root cause (Perplexity MCP tool only does shallow Sonar calls, not deep research), maps 30+ affected workflows into priority tiers, and proposes a 4-phase fix: (1) universal research engine with Quick/Standard/Deep depth levels, (2) MCP tool upgrade with two options, (3) tier-by-tier workflow rebuild, and (4) research quality gate. Includes verification plan and budget analysis. Requires user decision on MCP upgrade approach.
